name: popover
title: Popover
description: Filters, share links, and other controls tied to a trigger.

motionProfile.reason: Popover owns one anchored panel presence with a short anchor-side approach, clamped measured width and height, scoped surface paint and the title/description text, quantity and foreground owners; Base UI keeps positioning, focus, dismissal and unmount, and composed controls keep their own motion.

popup.anchored/one-shot.reason: The anchored panel owns one opacity and anchor-side approach envelope on its own visual layer; the positioner keeps its native coordinates and initial children inherit the entrance.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: The closing panel fades on its own opacity channel without moving the anchor, while Base UI retains its native completion protocol and unmount.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The panel shell owns one clamped measured width and height transaction over its natural content inside the positioned available space.

state.color/css-transition.reason: The panel owns its scoped surface paint and the title and description own their foreground paint; focus, invalid state or an unprovable caller palette settles that region immediately.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A directly supplied plain Title or Description string replaces only its changed graphemes; rich children keep their native identity and are composed, not recursively split.

number.roll/reels.reason: A directly supplied supported numeric quantity in Title or Description rolls only its changed places; strings, codes and dates remain text.
